status: New retrospective sensitivity prompted by peer review after the original results; not preregistered and not a replacement for the frozen primary analysis.
inputs: Only checksum-verified research/comovement/inputs/; prices end on 2026-06-30. No downloads, model refits or reserved June-2026 forward evaluation.
permutation_null: Conditional on the recorded sector labels and each sector's observed multiset of cluster labels, cluster assignments are exchangeable among instruments within that sector with respect to fixed subsequent return correlations. This is a conditional randomisation benchmark, not a causal claim or proof of exchangeability conditional on all company characteristics.

statistics.within_sector_difference: Mean correlation of same-sector/same-cluster pairs minus mean correlation of same-sector/different-cluster pairs; equal weight per eligible unique pair within each cell.
statistics.cluster_coefficient: Original additive OLS coefficient of shared cluster, controlling for shared sector and an intercept, over all eligible unique pairs. Reported separately because it is not the within-sector contrast.

pair_exclusion: Exclude the INL/INP mutual pair, as in the original analysis. Other overlapping pairs remain; permutations act on instruments, not independent pairs.
p_value: One-sided plus-one p=(1+count(null>=observed))/(5001). Report both unadjusted p and Holm-adjusted p across all 16 tests (2 dates x 2 methods x 2 return bases x 2 statistics).
uncertainty: 2,000 synchronous non-circular ten-trading-day moving-block bootstrap draws, matching original block construction; percentile 95% intervals for within-sector differences. Raw returns or already fitted market residuals are resampled, without re-estimating market coefficients. Intervals condition on observed groups/universe and are not simultaneous intervals.
interpretation: Exploratory robustness check only. Preserve negative and inconclusive outcomes. No claim of portfolio performance, causal effects or validation across independent market regimes. Original protocol and June-2026 held-out procedure remain unchanged.
return_basis: Unchanged primary vendor-close daily price returns; first forward return includes the formation close. J200 residuals use the original market_residuals function.
